text: Astley Down will host the annual Larkmere Kite Festival this weekend, drawing more than 4,000 visitors to the riverfront meadow, organizers said Tuesday. The two-day event, set for 16 and 17 August, will feature stunt kite displays, children’s workshops, food stalls and an evening lantern launch. Town clerk Maren Vale said preparations were complete and traffic diversions would begin Friday morning. “Astley Down is proud to welcome families from across the region for one of our most popular summer traditions,” Vale said. Police expect heavier-than-usual parking demand near Ferry Road and have advised attendees to use the temporary shuttle service from North Quay. Last year’s festival generated an estimated £180,000 for local businesses.
